title: Tracepod profile document (schema v2)
description: The profile JSON the sensor writes to profiles/<container-id>/files.json (standalone mode) or POSTs to the controller (DaemonSet mode). One document per container profiling window. See docs/profile-schema/README.md for the versioning policy and field semantics.

schema_version.description: Profile schema version. Always the integer 2 for documents matching this schema. A legacy pre-versioned profile carries the string "1" (or no field) and must be treated as v1.

container_id.description: Runtime container ID the sensor profiled.

image_ref.description: OCI image reference of the profiled container. Omitted in standalone mode when no image ref was resolved.

profile_start.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the aggregator was created (first witnessed start).

profile_end.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the profile was snapshotted (container stop).

coverage.description: Per-container coverage markers (R2). The sensor records raw signals; it does not score them.

process_start_observed.description: True only when the sensor can demonstrate it observed the container's main process from its first exec (its cgroup attachment won the NRI startup race). Any uncertainty resolves to false. A false value means startup code paths are systematically missing from this profile.

attach_time.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the sensor added the container's cgroup to the BPF allowlist — the earliest instant any event could be observed. The zero value (0001-01-01T00:00:00Z) means no attach was recorded.

first_exec_time.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp of the first exec event observed for the container. Omitted when no exec was observed during the window.

container_starts.description: Container starts the sensor witnessed during the window (R3), in observation order. A consumer counts full restarts within a profile as length-1, summing across the profiles emitted for a workload for cross-window totals.

timestamp.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp of the witnessed start.

files.description: Observed files, keyed by absolute path.

source.description: How the file entered the manifest. Load-bearing for confidence scoring and audit trails.

access_modes.description: Observed access modes: r (read), w (write), x (execute), l (link), m (mmap PROT_EXEC).

count.description: Number of observed opens. 0 for inferred-elf and directory-inclusion entries.

inferred_from.description: source=inferred-elf: the ELF binary that required this shared object.

included_because.description: source=directory-inclusion / manual: the reason the path was included.
